from pathlib import Path
import json
base=Path.home()/".local/share/prediction-project-executor/campaigns/FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
task="A2Z-V4-ASTRA-PREBUILD-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2"
rows=[]
for name in ("models/CONTINUATION.json","models/STATE.json"):
    p=base/name
    if not p.is_file():
        continue
    try:o=json.loads(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except Exception as e:
        rows.append({"file":name,"parse_error":type(e).__name__})
        continue
    if isinstance(o,dict) and o.get("task_id")==task:
        rows.append({
          "file":name,
          "task_id":o.get("task_id"),
          "state":o.get("state"),
          "reason":o.get("reason"),
          "attempt":o.get("attempt"),
          "checkpoint":o.get("checkpoint"),
          "retry_at":o.get("retry_at"),
          "next_action":o.get("next_action")
        })
print("ERROR_CLASS=R4P2_NEWEST_RETRY_STATE",flush=True)
print("ERROR="+json.dumps(rows,separators=(",",":"),sort_keys=True),flush=True)
raise SystemExit(1)
